name: Thaumaturgy (Way of Passage) — 2 Intermediate — Way of Passage

system.description:
Developed during the long war between Tremere and Tzimisce in Eastern Europe, this Path lets a thaumaturge grant swifter-than-normal movement and increased endurance to mounts, draft animals, and vehicles other than himself — horses run faster and farther, and wagons and siege engines move at greater speed for longer. This Path became obsolete after the 19th century, once steam-powered travel made it redundant. It does not work on humans, Cainites, or other supernatural creatures, nor does it substitute for Celerity or Fortitude; a faster mount does not grant its rider extra actions and may in fact hinder him in combat maneuvers. Only travel time is meaningfully improved.

System: The caster spends blood and Willpower and rolls to determine the duration of the effect (in days). Higher mastery of the Path increases the number of mounts or wagons that can be affected at once: a single mount at the lowest rating, rising through six mounts or one laden wagon, 12 mounts or four supply wagons, 24 mounts or eight wagons or one siege engine, up to 48 mounts or 16 wagons at the Path's height.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
system.bloodCost: Varies (1 Willpower Trait per Attribute affected)
